UGen Documentation

Introduction

UGen++ is a audio processing and synthesis framework in C++. It provides oscillators, filters, envelopes and event management etc. There are starter projects for Mac (using Juce), Windows (using Juce) and iPhone.

Installation

Check out the source code using SVN using the command: 
 svn co http://ugen.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/ ugen
In Xcode on the Mac for the Juce projects the directory containing Juce (i.e., juce.h) should be defined as a Source Tree "JUCE_SOURCE" such that it can be found using: 
 #include <juce/juce.h>

To use the iPhone project this is not necessary, just use the iPhone_UGen_AU/UGenRemoteIO.xcodeproj to get started.

Getting started

The best places to start are with the tutorials and/or looking through the available UGen classes . The UGen derived classes (and other classes) are categorised on the main modules page.
